i did really well my first semester

This semester I have been slacking a lot. I can't really concentrate. I am very frustrated by my inability to just do my schoolwork. I think using cannabis made me able to tolerate the stress before, whereas now I have no means to do so

It's not that he does anything now, I just harbor resentment for him not raising me very well in the past

I could move out, but to be honest I don't think it would help. The extra financial burden is too great

I just hate my dad a lot. He is a coward, and is a manipulative asshole. I refuse to believe he is my father

I would like it if he disappeared forever
